title: Define and enforce the DNA serializer compatibility and legacy-migration policy
description:
## Summary
The 2026-09-06 next-slice audit found two serializer-boundary policies are undocumented or silently lossy: legacy `verticalOffset` migration clamps silently, and unknown JSON fields have an implicit open-content policy.

## Scope
- F-306 (P1 as audited): Legacy `verticalOffset` migration routes through `JsonDnaSerializer.cs:122-124` -> `CurveAdapter.FromLegacyOffset` which clamps to [-1,1] (`CurveAdapter.cs:91`) silently before validation. Choose and document a strict (reject) vs repair (clamp + warn) vs versioned policy; add tests for -1/0/1/+/-1.001/NaN/inf.
- F-307 (P2): `JsonDnaSerializer` reads via RequireField/TryGetValue with no unknown-member scan (`JsonDnaSerializer.cs:493-580`), giving implicit open content. Document open/closed/open-with-diagnostics policy and add one locking test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The verticalOffset migration policy is explicit and non-silent; out-of-range/NaN/inf inputs have deterministic, tested behavior.
- The unknown-member (open/closed) compatibility policy is documented and covered by a test.

## Validation
Focused JsonDnaSerializer/Runtime tests; dotnet Tests build clean. No Unity scene required.

## Findings
Confirmed at HEAD d3c7f12e. Owner TSK-0036 (migration impl) and TSK-0126 (IDnaSerializer seam) are Done; this is a net-new contract follow-up. See docs/audits/creaturecreator-audit-synthesis-2026-09-06-batch.md.

## Blockers
None.

## Next Step
Decide policy with the owning slice, then implement + test.
